name: personal-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins: context status line, inbound-content guardrail, OKF knowledge bundle workflow.

plugins.name: context-status
plugins.description: Status line showing model, directory, git branch and context window usage.

plugins.name: jev-guard
plugins.description: Inbound-content guardrail: scans web, MCP and network Bash results for prompt injection with TypeSafe Jev.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: OKF knowledge bundle workflow: look up docs before work, update after, dedupe, keep index and log in sync. Ships read-only context and context-writer agents; SessionStart hook dispatches them when a bundle exists.

plugins.name: branch-indicator
plugins.description: Shows which git worktree (or branch) the session is working in, at session start and whenever it changes.
